name: RuntimeCompile
tagline: Dynamic in-memory Java runtime compilation helper.
description:
RuntimeCompile is a lightweight Java library for dynamic in-memory Java source compilation, JIT evaluation, and ClassLoader synthesis without temporary disk I/O.

Key Capabilities:
- In-Memory Source Compilation: Compile Java code strings directly into bytecode in RAM using javax.tools.JavaCompiler.
- Custom In-Memory ClassLoader: Load and instantiate dynamically compiled classes instantly.
- Zero Disk Footprint: Avoids writing temporary .java or .class files to disk for performance and security.
